literal_source_claim: A consistency proof for Peano arithmetic (PA).
canonical_claim: Provisional source-faithful scope: for a fixed recursive first-order presentation and proof calculus for Peano arithmetic, there is no finite derivation of contradiction; the proof is to be reconstructed through Gentzen-style ordinal reduction justified by a source-specified transfinite-induction principle below epsilon-zero. Exact encodings and metatheoretic strength are not yet frozen.
domain_and_universes: Open: a recursive first-order language for arithmetic, PA axiom schema or equivalent finite/inductive presentation, a concrete sequent or natural-deduction calculus, coded derivations, contradiction, an ordinal notation system representing ordinals below epsilon-zero, and a metatheory able to prove the required reduction and induction principles.
quantifiers: all purported finite derivations in the selected PA calculus
all ordinal-reduction steps or assigned ordinal notations used in normalization
all induction predicates in the exact source-authorized transfinite-induction schema
hypotheses: the selected calculus and PA axioms faithfully present first-order Peano arithmetic
the ordinal assignment decreases under the proof-reduction operation
the selected metatheory proves the exact transfinite-induction or well-foundedness principle needed for the notation system below epsilon-zero
conclusion: No derivation of contradiction exists in the selected formal calculus for PA; the literal consistency predicate and metatheoretic packaging remain to be selected from a pinpoint source.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Semantic satisfiability, simple consistency, omega-consistency, 1-consistency, and consistency of fragments such as PRA are not interchangeable. An arbitrary Lean-level WellFounded relation or mathlib's set-theoretic epsilon-zero is not automatically Gentzen's primitive-recursive notation system. Empty or weakened axiom systems and calculi with contradiction omitted are excluded as substitutes.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory as metatheory; the permitted classical principles and the relationship to Gentzen's finitistic metatheory remain to be frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports, generated syntax, reflection, and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No oracle, native computation, unchecked normalizer, or external certificate is credited; any proof reduction must be represented by kernel-checked definitions and theorems under the later computation policy
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter, formalizing PA as an object theory
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source edition or theorem selection, PA or calculus encoding, consistency notion, ordinal notation/metatheory boundary, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, trust profile, or validator change; independent reviewers and review due date remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. Relevant first-order and ordinal APIs elaborate, but PA syntax, derivability, Gentzen reduction, the exact transfinite-induction hypothesis, and the canonical target are not selected or proved. No H0, machine proof credit, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
